d: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney has concluded a trip to Saudi Arabia. He's the first Canadian PM to visit Saudi Arabia in 26 years. 13 deals have been signed over the course of Carney's trip to the Saudi Kingdom. He has brushed away concerns over Riyadh's human rights record, saying that "lecturing countries from afar is an ineffective strategy. Carney has spent the last few months trying to diversify Canada's partnerships. He has cosied up to European nations and other "middle powers."
